decisions.reason: The modular mobile waste processing plant (MMAK) shows a strong quantified customer benefit of over 600,000 euros in annual savings and fits the firm's strategy toward modular solutions.
The slow-speed shredder is a core product close to the established offer and has its own page, so it is likely central to the portfolio.
This second modular plant concept is only mentioned on the website and may overlap with Product A, but it aligns with the firm's modular strategy and is worth keeping in a growing market.
The mobile trommel screen complements the shredder line, is close to the core business, and is low-risk to maintain alongside parts and service revenue.
